title: Admin logchain: compact index, WORM checkpoints, and automated provenance reporting
creator: Lin Chen
description: Goal: Provide a compact, append-only admin action index ("logchain") that can be efficiently stored to WORM-backed exports, supports residency-aware retention policies, and generates automated, verifiable evidence bundles for compliance audits. Scope covers admin actions, permission changes, config updates, and cross-region access events. Deliverables: (1) a space-efficient index format with checkpoints, (2) signer/anchor flow for cryptographic verification, (3) export/playback API for legal/forensics teams, (4) automation to produce periodic evidence bundles and upload to sealed storage or escrow. Must integrate with existing audit capture pipeline and Console querying without leaking sensitive payloads.
comments: 2026-02-12 — Kickoff: aligned with PM and compliance. Agreed compact index will be append-only protobufs with delta compression. Decided to prototype with current audit stream as source-of-truth.

2026-02-18 — Prototype update: implemented serializer and delta diffs for repeated admin_action entries. Initial size reduction ~6x on dev traffic. Upload path to sealed S3 bucket validated (encryption and bucket policies).

2026-02-25 — Security review note: HSM signing integration required for final anchor step. Contacted security to scope KMS vs HSM; HSM preferred for legal attestation. Action: ENG-701245 referenced for HSM onboarding.

2026-03-01 — Design review: PM requested per-customer residency tags on index manifests so exports can be partitioned by region. UX/design to add a retention selector in Console later (paired ticket).

2026-03-04 — Current blockers: (1) canonical ordering for multi-region federated writes — working with infra on causal ordering guarantees, (2) HSM provisioning for signing sandbox pending procurement.
decisions: Use a compact protobuf-based index with variable-length delta encodings to reduce export size.
Anchors will be generated per-export using HSM-backed signing and optionally notarized via an external timestamping service.
Retention enforcement is policy-driven: index manifests carry residency and retention metadata; export job consults policy engine before finalizing WORM storage.
Console will surface provenance artifacts but not raw sensitive payloads; proofs and hashes are exposed for verification instead.
Evidence bundles will include: manifest.json, index.bin, checkpoints.sig, and an export provenance report (JSON) for auditors.
tasks: Serializer: implement delta encoding + compact field map (in progress)
Checkpointing: HSM signing integration and signature format (blocked - procurement)
Export flow: residency-aware export orchestrator and retry semantics
Console: add export provenance viewer and retention selector (PM pairing)
Automation: scheduled evidence bundle generation and S3 WORM/lock lifecycle hooks
Testing: end-to-end integrity verification harness and tamper-detection tests
